content:
The **Giant Teapot Red Rocket** is an unmarked location in The Forest region of Appalachia.

A small Red Rocket gas station just off I-59, built next to The Giant Teapot roadside attraction.

Southeast of the teapot, there is a rusted pickup truck with a number of explosive canisters in the back, sitting next to the inoperational gas pumps outside. Inside the building are assorted junk and consumable items including a box of Sugar Bombs on one of the shelves.

There is a Stash Box in the corner of the station. There is also a Weapons Workbench behind the building, next to one of the boiler pipes which needs to be protected as part of the Event: Tea Time event.

The Giant Teapot Red Rocket filling station appears in *Fallout 76*.

At night
